readerCopy.body: An old survival instinct may become useful once it no longer has to run the whole situation. Lilith trine the South Node can give easy access to a familiar refusal, boundary, or instinct for noticing where something is trying to make you smaller or more compliant. You may trust the signal quickly because you have seen the pattern before. Keep the discernment. You do not have to repeat the old exit, fight, or secrecy just because the warning system still works.
